subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When review demand is consumed, impl-review shall read the merge lane's unchanged risk class, project it through the unchanged class-to-band policy as `skip`, `standard`, or `deep`, and pass that actual band to FR-24 without computing another proposal-risk classifier; `skip` shall denote only the lowest projected band and never authorize zero model-backed review.
rationale: one classifier remains authoritative while the universal review floor closes the lowest-risk bypass
fit_criterion: every existing class fixture projects the same band byte-for-byte; every `skip` fixture reaches at least `standard×1`; inspection finds no review-side risk derivation or `skipped:<class>` terminal
